304397.text: A nucleus travelling with a velocity v emits an -particle. Let the velocities of the -particle and the residual nucleus be v ₁ and v ₂ , and let their masses be m₁ and m₂ , respectively. Which of the following statements is true?

Thus, m₁ v ₁ + m₂ v ₂ must be parallel to v .
